Name: Realistic Hunger
Author: SilverFrogEater
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This is a Multiplayer hunger system which makes food more relevant, is not too punishing, and maintains a sense of realism. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Just put it in your Mods folder like normal. The config file will populate on first start-up.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
To avoid hunger, eat at least 100 energy per day (modifiable from config).

Negative Effect: "Hungry"
This triggers the day after you did not eat enough, but had something. You wake up with half energy (configurable) and the debuff slows your speed slightly. The debuff persists until you've eaten 150 energy worth of food (configurable). If you haven't eaten enough by the time you pass out, you wake up Starving.

Negative Effect: "Starving"
If you eat nothing - or if you went to bed Hungry, you wake up with the Starving debuff. Start the day with 0 energy (configurable), and you'll be relegated to walk speed (like exhaustion).  The debuff persists until you've eaten 100 energy worth of food (configurable) to drop down to hungry or 250 energy to fully eliminate it. If you haven't eaten enough by the time you pass out, you wake up in the clinic and are billed 10% of your current money, up to 15k (configurable), and you wake up "Hungry". Hungry includes the same modifiers mentioned above.

This ensures you will eat something substantial, but doesn't force you to refill your energy before managing your day. This is meant to increase immersion.

Early game can be quite rough. So I buffed the early game by adding 4, highly accessible recipes which can be made at any campfire and make eating more plausible.
[list]
[*]Fireside Fish (1 wood, 1 fish) gives 75 energy[/*]
[*]Wild Herb Salad (3 forageables, unless they give negative energy) gives 130 energy[/*]
[*]Roasted Vegetables (1 vegetable) gives 90 energy[/*]
[*]Hot-Stone Soup (1 Stone, 1 egg, 1 vegetable) gives 110 energy[/*]
[*]Can O' Beans (1 Green bean, 1 Sugar) gives 90 energy[/*]
[/list]To use the Campfire, you just walk all the way up to one and use the 'Use Tool button' (left click on computer). You can craft your own from level 0 or visit Linus and use his instead. Using a campfire will not access the refrigerators inside your home, even if you bring the fire inside.

Other recipes I added which can be cooked at the campfire:
[list]
[*]Smore (1 Graham Cracker, 1 Chocolate Bar, 1 Marshmallow) gives +1 Luck[/*]
[*]Spicy Can O' Beans ( 1 Green bean, 1 Sugar, 1 hot pepper) gives +1 Speed[/*]
[/list]The ingredients for Smores must be cooked in the kitchen.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]You don't need anything else but I recommend "GMCM" to modify the config value easily and "Category Ingredient Display Fix" to fix a couple icons for the recipes I made for early game use.[/color]
